integrity: Exact free-face proof and independent finite verifier scripts included; no claim of external audit or author provenance.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the ordinary 3-cut complex of Q_d, d>=3; the d=3 special case is already known. No equivariant homotopy or higher cut-parameter classification is asserted. The all-dimensional statement has a symbolic proof; numerical tests cover d=3..6 only. Unindexed equivalent literature remains a risk.
title: Two adjacent sphere dimensions in ordinary three-cut complexes of Boolean hypercubes
